sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), "description" TEXT NULL, "why" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'ACHIEVED', 'DROPPED')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_nodes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "parent_node_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), "description" TEXT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (order_index >= 0), "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (id, goal_id), FOREIGN KEY (parent_node_id, goal_id) REFERENCES goal_nodes (id, goal_id), CHECK (parent_node_id IS NULL OR parent_node_id <> id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "missions" ("goal_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "goal_node_id" TEXT NULL CHECK(goal_node_id IS NULL OR goal_id IS NOT NULL) REFERENCES goal_nodes (id), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "why" TEXT NULL, "verification_policy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SELF_REPORT', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "evidence_waived_at" INTEGER NULL, "source_mission_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES missions (id), "relation_type" TEXT NULL CHECK (relation_type IS NULL OR relation_type = 'RETRY'), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER missions_ownership_insert BEFORE INSERT ON missions WHEN NEW.goal_node_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM goal_nodes WHERE id = NEW.goal_node_id AND goal_id = NEW.goal_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'mission node must belong to goal');END

CREATE TRIGGER missions_ownership_update BEFORE UPDATE OF goal_id, goal_node_id ON missions WHEN NEW.goal_node_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM goal_nodes WHERE id = NEW.goal_node_id AND goal_id = NEW.goal_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'mission node must belong to goal');END
CREATE INDEX goal_nodes_siblings ON goal_nodes (goal_id, parent_node_id, order_index)
CREATE INDEX missions_goal_node ON missions (goal_id, goal_node_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mission_schedule_revisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mission_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES missions (id), "revision_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scheduled_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_policy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FLEXIBLE', "fixed_start_at" INTEGER NULL, "planned_duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "evidence_deadline_at" INTEGER NULL, "change_reason" TEXT NULL, "changed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("mission_id", "revision_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mission_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES missions (id), "objective" TEXT NOT NULL, "steps" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "verification_criteria" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "execution_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mission_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES missions (id), "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "schedule_revision_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES mission_schedule_revisions (id), "granted_duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "user_reported_result" TEXT NULL, "submit_optional_evidence" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("submit_optional_evidence" IN (0, 1)), "is_retrospective" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_retrospective" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("mission_id", "sequence"), CHECK (sequence > 0), CHECK (type IN ('START', 'PAUSE', 'RESUME', 'EXTEND', 'STOP', 'END')), CHECK (granted_duration_minutes > 0), CHECK (user_reported_result IN ('COMPLETED', 'NOT_COMPLETED')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "failure_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mission_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES missions (id), "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "user_reason_category" TEXT NULL, "user_reason_text" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("mission_id", "trigger"), CHECK ("trigger" IN ('USER_MARKED_NOT_COMPLETED', 'EVIDENCE_DEADLINE_MISSED')), CHECK (user_reason_category IN ('TIME_INSUFFICIENT', 'TOO_DIFFICULT', 'URGENT_EVENT', 'BAD_STATE', 'DO_NOT_WANT_CONTINUE', 'ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM', 'OTHER')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "evidence_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mission_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES missions (id), "submission_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NULL, "attachment_storage_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "attachment_file_name" TEXT NULL, "attachment_mime_type" TEXT NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NULL, "submitted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "supersedes_evidence_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES evidence_records (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (((type IN ('TEXT', 'CODE', 'MANUAL_RECORD')) AND source = 'USER' AND content IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(content)) > 0 AND attachment_storage_key IS NULL AND attachment_file_name IS NULL AND attachment_mime_type IS NULL) OR (type = 'IMAGE' AND source IN ('FILE_SYSTEM', 'CAMERA') AND attachment_storage_key IS NOT NULL AND attachment_file_name IS NOT NULL) OR (type = 'FILE' AND source = 'FILE_SYSTEM' AND attachment_storage_key IS NOT NULL AND attachment_file_name IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_receipts" ("schema_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "package_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "node_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mission_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("schema_name", "package_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assistant_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mission_id" TEXT NULL, "node_id" TEXT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NULL, "writer_token" TEXT NULL, "writer_lease_until" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assistant_session_records" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assistant_sessions (id), "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "ignorable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ignorable" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "sequence"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "operation_receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX mission_schedule_fixed ON mission_schedule_revisions (time_policy, fixed_start_at, mission_id, revision_number)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX execution_events_one_start ON execution_events (mission_id) WHERE type = 'START'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX execution_events_one_end ON execution_events (mission_id) WHERE type = 'END'
CREATE INDEX evidence_records_mission ON evidence_records (mission_id, submitted_at, id)
CREATE INDEX import_receipts_content ON import_receipts (schema_name, content_sha256)
CREATE INDEX assistant_sessions_updated ON assistant_sessions (updated_at, id)
CREATE INDEX operation_receipts_entity ON operation_receipts (kind, entity_id)
